title: AEF 1.0: run.json
description: The header of one run folder. Identity lives here, not in the folder path.

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this document follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

runId.description: The run's id. A producer never reuses it for a different run; identity lives here, never in the folder path (RUN-1, RUN-13).

status.description: running while the producer writes; completed or aborted when it closes. There is no 'sealed' status: sealed is a fact about seal.json, never a field.

abortReason.description: Why the run was aborted. Required when status is aborted (RUN-5).

producer.description: The tool that wrote the run: its name, its version and, optionally, the runtime it ran on.

name.description: The producer's name. Part of the producer comparability axis (LANE-6).

version.description: The producer's exact version, compared byte for byte. Part of the producer comparability axis (ENC-10, LANE-6).

runtime.description: The runtime the producer ran on.

ref.description: The evaluated subject, as a typed reference. Compared by the subject comparability axis (RUN-6, LANE-6).

kind.description: What the subject is: agent, workflow, model, endpoint, mcp-server (an MCP server) or other. A reader shows a kind it does not know as written and treats it as other (RUN-6, VER-3).

version.description: The subject's exact version. Required when the run serves a checkpoint: a run without it is not eligible for a lane (RUN-6, LANE-1).

environment.description: The environment the subject ran in, as the producer names it.

externalIds.description: The subject's ids in other systems, by system name; each value is a string or null.

telemetry.description: The keys that join this subject to OpenTelemetry (gen_ai.agent.id, service.name).

agentId.description: The subject's gen_ai.agent.id in its OpenTelemetry traces.

serviceName.description: The subject's service.name in its OpenTelemetry traces.

ref.description: The deployment, as a typed reference. Compared by the deployment comparability axis (LANE-6).

environment.description: The deployment's environment, as the producer names it.

endpoint.description: Where the subject was reached. Never with credentials: no user information before the host (spec 03, RUN-10).

externalIds.description: The deployment's ids in other systems, by system name; each value is a string or null.

suite.description: The test cases run. A frozen suite's digest identifies its exact content.

ref.description: The suite, as a typed reference. With version, compared by the suite comparability axis (RUN-8, LANE-6).

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the suite's content, when the content is frozen. Compared by the suite-content comparability axis (RUN-8, LANE-6).

frozen.description: True when the suite's content is frozen, so that digest identifies it (RUN-8).

executionPolicy.description: How many trials each case had, and how they were combined (RUN-8).

trialsPerCase.description: Trials per case, from 1 to 1000. With more than one, each trial has its own lines and the case has a rollup line (RES-8).

requirePasses.description: How many of a case's trials must pass for the case to pass, from 1 to 1000.

aggregation.description: How a case's trials are combined: MajorityVote, the only value in this version.

judges.description: The models that graded results, in order. The judges and rubrics comparability axes compare this list in order (RUN-9, LANE-6).

model.description: The judge model, as its provider names it. Part of the judges comparability axis (RUN-9, LANE-6).

mode.description: How the judge was used: single (alone), panel (one judge of a panel), primary (its grade counts) or shadow (it grades alongside, without counting). A reader shows a mode it does not know as written (RUN-9, VER-3).

panelSize.description: How many judges the panel had, when mode is panel.

rubricDigest.description: The SHA-256 of the rubric the judge graded with. Part of the rubrics comparability axis (RUN-9, LANE-6).

calibration.description: The producer's claim about how far this judge agreed with labelled cases before the run (spec 03, RUN-9).

labelSet.description: The labelled cases, as a typed reference.

accuracy.description: Share of decided cases where the judge agreed with the label.

kappa.description: Cohen's kappa between the judge and the labels.

measuredAt.description: When the calibration was measured, before this run (RUN-9).

config.description: The run's configuration as the producer applied it. thresholds maps a metric (or result path) to the rule its verdict used.

thresholds.description: Per metric or result path, the rule the producer's verdict used, recorded for display.

op.description: How the measured value is compared with value: >=, >, <=, < or ==.

value.description: The threshold the measured value is compared with.

endedAt.description: When the run closed: required for a completed or aborted run, absent while it is running, and never earlier than startedAt (RUN-5).

otel.description: The OpenTelemetry conventions the run's traces follow (RUN-14).

semconvVersion.description: The version of the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions the traces use, as MAJOR.MINOR or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (RUN-14).

dialects.description: The semantic-convention namespaces the traces use, such as gen_ai.

contentCapture.description: What text the run keeps: on (prompts, responses, tool arguments and judge reasoning may be kept, in blobs) or off (none of it, and no digest of it). A producer SHOULD write it; a reader treats a run without it as on (RUN-11).

costPolicy.description: The spending limit and the price table the producer used to estimate cost.

maxUsd.description: The spending limit, in US dollars.

priceTable.description: The price table the producer used to estimate cost, by name.

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a credential (ENC-19, RUN-10).

provenance.description: Written by a runner into every run it produces: the plan (by id and digest), the job and the runner. Sealed with run.json, it ties the run to the job that made it (RUN-12).

planId.description: The id of the plan the run was produced for (RUN-12).

planDigest.description: The SHA-256 of the plan file's exact bytes (RUN-12, PLAN-5).

jobId.description: The job that produced the run (RUN-12).

runnerId.description: The runner that produced the run (RUN-12).

execution.description: How the evaluated target was driven (spec 03, RUN-7). Only live evidence describes how the subject behaves.

targetMode.description: live: the real subject at run time; replayed: its recorded answers played back; scripted: a scripted stand-in; mocked: a stand-in that is not the subject.

stimulus.description: Where the inputs came from: a fixed suite, generated at run time, imported from another tool, or other.

endedAt.description: An aborted run has an end time (RUN-5).
A completed run has an end time (RUN-5).

allOf.description: An open run has not ended.

status.description: Applies to a run that is still running (RUN-5).
